product: Real fm-watch.sh and fm-wake-drain.sh with installed gh 2.102.0, a disposable HTTPS GraphQL endpoint, and marked lab homes inside the run worktree.

setup_corrections: The installed gh sanitizes U+0001 to literal ^A even in raw API output; the reason assertion follows the actual CLI input, preserving Unicode, quotes and multiline escaping.
Cleanup requires a full tmux session:window endpoint and worktree identity in task metadata; corrected disposable metadata before re-driving the boundary.

Shortened 3/4/6-second artificial stall limits caused valid command startup to look stalled. Final live liveness checks use the production 900-second bound and age only the existing lab beacon. The two regression tests now expire and observe that same beacon between each completed read.
A transient runner was rewritten while its prior process was finishing. The final stable runner supersedes that setup-only EOF error.

regression_proof.prior_result: expected failure: a completed poll left the next poll beacon expired

test_result: Final targeted selectors passed; the same final liveness regression fails as expected on the pre-R35 watcher.
intentional_source_change: tests/fm-pr-check-security.test.sh: expire the existing beacon between reads at the production 900-second stall bound, observe freshness after each completion, and retain final-removal and re-arm assertions.
cleanup: All disposable labs, API servers and temporary selection scripts were removed; git status shows only the intentional tests/fm-pr-check-security.test.sh repair. Existing .agent-state material was preserved.
